cours_periode.name: cours_periode
cours_periode.value: "cours"."date_debut" IS NULL OR "cours"."date_fin" IS NULL OR "cours"."date_debut" <= "cours"."date_fin"

invitation_contenu.name: invitation_contenu
invitation_contenu.value: ("invitation"."type" = 'invitation' AND "invitation"."role" IS NOT NULL) OR ("invitation"."type" = 'reinitialisation' AND "invitation"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

reduction_valeur.name: reduction_valeur
reduction_valeur.value: "reduction"."taux_points_base" IS NOT NULL OR "reduction"."montant_centimes" IS NOT NULL
